record.question: Which position India managed at Commonwealth Games, 2018 in Australia?
record.explanation: Answer B: 3rd. India finished third in the standard gold-first medal table at the 2018 Gold Coast Commonwealth Games. The Sports Ministry’s original 2018 review records 26 gold, 20 silver and 20 bronze medals, 66 in total, and third place. The ranking is the gold-first country table; simply sorting by total medals would give a different order. Historical/source note: Third in the conventional gold-first overall medal table; this is not a ranking by total medal count alone. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1555310&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
